50x30 mm. The safety distance determines the size of mesh required. The
Classic 50x30 mesh requires a minimum distance of 200 mm while the
Premium 50x20 only requires 120 mm.

## Product Information

</div>

<div class="md:col-span-6 md:col-start-6">

<div class="rich-text block *:max-w-none *:first:mt-0 *:last:mb-0">

The Classic 50x30 comes in four heights. The 750 mm panel is only used
as an extension panel to the other heights. The panels come in thirteen
widths, with the exception of the 1300 mm panel, which comes in fourteen
widths. All panels have a 30x20 mm frame with factory-fixed brackets to
facilitate assembly.

The mesh consists of vertical wires of Ø 3 mm and horizontal wires of Ø
2.5 mm.

The standard panel colour is black (RAL 9011) but customised colours are
available upon request. 

 

The Premium 50x20 is 2200 mm in height and comes in six widths. All
panels have a 30x20 mm frame with factory-fixed brackets to facilitate
assembly.

The mesh consists of vertical wires of Ø 3 mm and horizontal wires of Ø
2.5 mm. 

The standard panel colour is black (RAL 9011) but customised colours are
available upon request.
